categories.managed: Deployed and maintained via CI/CD pipeline. Changes tracked in git.
categories.isv: Third-party vendor packages. NOT managed by CI/CD. Updates come from vendor.
categories.one-time: One-time migration/setup scripts. Should NOT be republished (may re-run seed SQL).
categories.legacy: Previously managed by CI/CD but now sunset. Stays published on instance but not actively deployed or maintained. Remove manually via SM204505 if no longer needed.
categories.deprecated: No longer active. Safe to delete from instance. DO NOT publish.
categories.incident-response: Emergency packages deployed outside CI/CD during production incidents. Track for orphan detection. DO NOT republish without explicit review — these packages were deployed under pressure and may have been superseded by production restore.

validation_rules.managed_must_have_repo_dir: Every 'managed' project must have a repo_dir pointing to Customization/{name}/
validation_rules.deprecated_must_not_publish: Projects with category 'deprecated' must never be included in publishBegin
validation_rules.one_time_must_not_republish: Projects with category 'one-time' must not be republished (ISV republish re-runs seed SQL)
validation_rules.unknown_projects_block_deploy: Any project found on instance that's not in this manifest blocks the deploy
validation_rules.incident_response_must_not_republish: Projects with category 'incident-response' must not be republished without explicit review. They were deployed as emergency fixes during an incident and may have been superseded by a production restore.
